metadata.title: Community
metadata.description: SAIN is three local chapters, in Utrecht, Groningen and Amsterdam: weekly discussion groups, free courses, hackathons and talks. Find your chapter and see what is on.

hero.heading: One community, in three cities.
hero.intro: SAIN is its chapters. Utrecht, Groningen and Amsterdam each run their own discussion groups, free courses and evenings, on a shared curriculum and under one national organisation. Pick the one nearest you and walk in.
hero.discordNote: Our Discord community currently focuses on our SAIN Amsterdam, Utrecht and Groningen chapters. More cities to come.

startChapter.printsLabel: The chapters so far, and the next to come
startChapter.heading: The next chapter starts with one meetup.
startChapter.intro: No chapter in your city yet? The three that exist all started the same way: a few people who wanted a local AI safety community and were willing to host the first meetup. SAIN’s leadership guides founders through the whole process, and new chapters operate under the national stichting, so no separate legal entity is needed.
startChapter.newCities: In Eindhoven, Delft or The Hague? We are looking for paid starting teams there right now. <link>See the starting roles</link>
startChapter.proposeNote: Send us an email with your city and a few things about you.
provides: The SAIN brand and national recognition
steps: Write to us about your city.
Work through the founding process with SAIN's leadership.
Set up your local channels and your chapter page on this site.
Do the first outreach and run the first meetup.
When you are ready, run a first course; the curriculum and guides are part of the kit.

close.heading: Nobody in these photographs knew anyone the first time either.
close.body: Come to one session in the city nearest you. If you want to do more than attend, every chapter has volunteer work waiting.
